<div class="wc-intro">
<p>This page lists the changes to the report Identifying NYC Parks with Vehicle Traffic that a reader would notice, newest first, including corrections when we published something wrong.</p>
<ul><li><strong>History begins:</strong> 2026-09-15, the day the report was first published. Dates are the day each version went up on the site, in New York time. Corrections made before this date may be missing.</li><li><strong>Data refresh:</strong> none. The list of parks comes from NYC Open Data as it stood when the report was last built, and it does not update on its own.</li></ul>
<p>To report a bug in the report, or to ask for a new feature, <a href="https://github.com/BetaNYC/roads-in-nyc-parks/issues">open an issue on GitHub</a>.</p>

<article class="wc-entry" id="2026-09-15-the-report-is-published-with-a-list-of-481-parks" data-tags="Site Data" aria-labelledby="2026-09-15-the-report-is-published-with-a-list-of-481-parks-title">
<h2 id="2026-09-15-the-report-is-published-with-a-list-of-481-parks-title">The report is published, with a list of 481 parks</h2>
<p class="wc-meta"><time datetime="2026-09-15">September 15, 2026</time></p>
<p class="wc-tags"><span class="wc-visually-hidden">Tags: </span><span class="wc-tag">Site</span><span class="wc-visually-hidden">, </span><span class="wc-tag">Data</span></p>
<p>In answer to a request from New Yorkers for Parks, the report lists NYC parks that appear to let cars drive through them: every park that contains a road segment cars can use, except Central Park and Prospect Park. It finds 481 of 2,059 parks, and says the list includes some parks that do not belong and needs to be checked by hand. The list can be downloaded as a spreadsheet (CSV) and as a map file (GeoJSON). Wording edits and a source note for the City&#x27;s street map data followed the same day.</p>
<p><strong>More detail:</strong> <a href="https://github.com/BetaNYC/roads-in-nyc-parks/commit/1f10560">The commit</a> · <a href="https://github.com/BetaNYC/roads-in-nyc-parks/commits/main/?since=2026-09-15&amp;until=2026-09-16">Same-day edits</a></p>
<p class="wc-permalink"><a href="#2026-09-15-the-report-is-published-with-a-list-of-481-parks">Link to this change<span class="wc-visually-hidden">: The report is published, with a list of 481 parks</span></a></p>
</article>
<script>
(function () {
  var roots = document.querySelectorAll("[data-whats-changed]");
  Array.prototype.forEach.call(roots, function (root) {
    var box = root.querySelector(".wc-filters");
    var status = root.querySelector(".wc-status");
    var entries = root.querySelectorAll(".wc-entry");
    if (!box || !status || !entries.length) return;
    var tagBoxes = box.querySelectorAll("input[name='wc-tag']");
    var corrBox = box.querySelector("input[name='wc-corrections']");
    var total = entries.length;
    var noun = total === 1 ? "change" : "changes";
    function apply() {
      var on = {};
      Array.prototype.forEach.call(tagBoxes, function (b) { on[b.value] = b.checked; });
      var shown = 0;
      Array.prototype.forEach.call(entries, function (el) {
        var tags = (el.getAttribute("data-tags") || "").split(" ");
        var ok = tags.some(function (t) { return on[t]; });
        if (corrBox && corrBox.checked && tags.indexOf("Correction") < 0) ok = false;
        el.hidden = !ok;
        if (ok) shown++;
      });
      status.textContent = shown === total
        ? "Showing all " + total + " " + noun + "."
        : "Showing " + shown + " of " + total + " " + noun + ".";
    }
    function reveal() {
      var id = decodeURIComponent(location.hash.slice(1));
      var el = id && document.getElementById(id);
      if (el && root.contains(el) && el.closest(".wc-entry[hidden]")) {
        Array.prototype.forEach.call(tagBoxes, function (b) { b.checked = true; });
        if (corrBox) corrBox.checked = false;
        apply();
        el.scrollIntoView();
      }
    }
    box.addEventListener("change", apply);
    window.addEventListener("hashchange", reveal);
    box.hidden = false;
  });
})();
</script>
</div>
